Class BasicSelectionCriteria

  • Object
    • BasicSelectionCriteria
  • All Implemented Interfaces:

    Direct Known Subclasses:

    public class BasicSelectionCriteria
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Describes elementay selection criteria for selections within a data record on its table table.
